mapper.insert: INSERT INTO catalog_snapshots(cache_key,items_json,fetched_at,expires_at) VALUES(#{cacheKey},#{itemsJson},#{fetchedAt},#{expiresAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE items_json=#{itemsJson},fetched_at=#{fetchedAt},expires_at=#{expiresAt}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM catalog_snapshots WHERE expires_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
